tasks.details:
Wire the new Unified Agent Runtime Loop into the CPU so it can be triggered from the command line, bus events, and cron jobs.

Three integration paths:
1. CPU Command: `agent.run "goal"` — fastest way to test the runtime from CLI
2. Bus Event: `AgentRun { goal }` message handler in cpu/bus_handlers.rs
3. Cron Trigger: autonomous background execution (e.g. every 5s maintain system state)

Goal: make the runtime loop a first-class citizen of the Agent OS event and command system.

Add cron job for autonomous runtime execution (e.g. maintain system state)
Emit AgentFinished / AgentError bus events on completion
Write tests for command, bus, and cron integration paths

tasks.description: Integrate the existing planning/ module (planner.rs, reflection.rs) with the new Unified Agent Runtime Loop via a thin adapter layer so the runtime can use the current planner to produce structured AgentStep actions.
tasks.details: This task does not modify the existing planner. It creates a Planner trait + PlannerOutput and a ReflectionPlannerAdapter that wraps planning/planner.rs and planning/reflection.rs, ensuring compatibility with the LLM Router and Tool Supervisor.
